entries.title: The Universim

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Universim reached its full 1.0 release on January 22, 2024 and is officially listed for Windows, macOS, and Linux. No sourced console or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it has the cleanest capture/settings path while preserving the same complete 1.0 content route as the other native desktop versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam or Crytivo. macOS and Linux are valid native alternatives if they are the available local setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched 1.0 build.
